panes.name: tests
panes.prompt: Run npm test and fix whatever fails. Explain each fix.

panes.name: docs
panes.prompt: Check that the pages in guide/ match the CLI in ../src and list anything out of date.

panes.name: review
panes.prompt: Review the uncommitted changes and point out bugs.

release.description: Final checks before tagging a release

panes.name: changelog
panes.prompt: Compare CHANGELOG.md with git log since the last tag and list missing entries.

panes.name: smoke
panes.prompt: Run npm pack, install the tarball into a temp prefix and try --help, doctor and --dry-run.
